The old ship dropped its [anchor] near the edge of the bay. A narrow [bridge] connected the dock to the fishing town. Every evening someone placed a [candle] in the window of the lighthouse keeper's house.

The [harbor] was quiet at dawn, and the water looked like glass. A worker leaned a wooden [ladder] against the wall to repair the roof. Beyond the road, a wide [meadow] stretched toward the hills.

At the far end grew an [orchard] full of ripe apples. A child picked up a smooth [pebble] and threw it into the stream. The stone [quarry] above the valley had been closed for many years. Soon the whole [village] gathered in the square to share a simple meal.
